dialogue.content: (こんにちわ、本日は宜しくお願いいたします)
dialogue.English: (Hello, thank you for coming in today.)

dialogue.content: (よろしくお願いします）
dialogue.English: (Yes, thank you.)

dialogue.content: (お時間１５時までお待ちした方がいいでしょうか？)
dialogue.English: Would you prefer that we wait until 3:00 p.m.?

dialogue.content: （大丈夫です）
dialogue.English: (That's fine.)

dialogue.content: (では始めましょう)
dialogue.English: (Then let's begin.)

dialogue.content: こんにちわ　相談員です　本日は宜しくお願いいたしますまず　年齢と性別を教えてください
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor. Thank you for coming today. First, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 15才女子です
dialogue.English: I'm a 15-year-old girl.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます　本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: いじめじゃないけど、クラスの人から無視されて、いつも一人でいる感じです
dialogue.English: It's not exactly bullying, but people in my class ignore me, and I always feel like I'm by myself.

dialogue.content: いじめでは無いけれど無視をされているように感じているのですね　　いつも一人でいるのは寂しいですね　もう少し詳しくお話いただけますか？
dialogue.English: So you feel like you're being ignored, even though it's not bullying. It must be lonely to always be by yourself. Could you tell me a little more about it?

dialogue.content: クラスの女子が私と話してくれないんです
dialogue.English: The girls in my class won't talk to me.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます　　クラスの全員からでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing. Is it from everyone in the class?

dialogue.content: 男子には少し話せる人いるけど、学校では話しにくいから大体一人で話さないでいます
dialogue.English: There are a few boys I can talk to, but it's hard to talk at school, so I usually just keep to myself and stay quiet.

dialogue.content: 一部の男性以外とはほとんどお話をされていない状況なのですね　　お辛いですね話にくいとおっしゃられるのは　どのようなところがそのような感じなのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: So you're in a situation where you hardly talk to anyone except for a few boys. That sounds difficult. When you say it's hard to talk, what makes you feel that way?

dialogue.content: みんなが見てくるから
dialogue.English: Because everyone stares.

dialogue.content: そんなにつらくないけど
dialogue.English: It's not that bad, though.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね　周りの様子に気を使われていらっしゃるんですね
dialogue.English: I see. So you're conscious of how others are watching you.

dialogue.content: いつから　そのように思われているのですか？
dialogue.English: How long have you been feeling this way?

dialogue.content: 気は使ってないけど、なんか空気で話さなくなりました。このクラスになってからだから1年近くです
dialogue.English: It’s not that I’m trying to be considerate; it’s more like the vibe made me stop talking. It’s been happening since I got into this class, so for nearly a year.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね　今のクラスになってからそう感じてきたのですねその当時に何か気になることとか　思いだすことはありますか？
dialogue.English: I see. So you started feeling this way after joining your current class. Do you remember anything from that time that stood out to you?

dialogue.content: 別にきっかけとかは思い出せないです
dialogue.English: I can't really remember any specific trigger.

dialogue.content: もともとおしゃべりな方じゃないし、自然とグループみたいな女の子の友達の塊に入れなかったみたいな感じ
dialogue.English: I'm not a very talkative person to begin with, and I just sort of naturally didn't fit into the groups of girls that formed.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね　自然とグループができていったので　その中にはいるタイミングをのがしてしまった感じでしょうか
dialogue.English: I see. So the groups formed naturally, and you feel like you missed the chance to join one?

dialogue.content: はい、もうグループとか出来ちゃってたし入りたいわけでもないんですけど、まぁ、一人だなって
dialogue.English: Yes, the groups were already formed, and it's not that I particularly want to join, but well, I realize I'm alone.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね　ご自分からグループの中に入っていこうとまでは思わなくて　一人でいたら　段々と無視をされてきたのですねなんとなく寂しさを感じてきたのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. You didn't feel like actively trying to join a group, and as you spent more time on your own, you gradually felt more ignored. Have you been feeling somewhat lonely?

dialogue.content: 寂しいと言うより疲れます。早く高校へ行きたい
dialogue.English: It's more tiring than lonely. I just want to go to high school already.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね　疲れてきちゃったのですね一人で悶々としていると勉強も手につかなくなってしまいますよね
dialogue.English: I see—it's become exhausting. When you're stewing over things by yourself, it can be hard to focus on your studies, can't it?

dialogue.content: 勉強は自慢ではないけど私、成績がいいんです
dialogue.English: I'm not bragging, but my grades are good.

dialogue.content: 周りの事考えるよりは、本読んだりしてる方が気が楽なので
dialogue.English: It's easier on my mind to read books than to think about what's going on around me.

dialogue.content: そうですか　それは良かったです一人でいると集中できる時間も多いしご自分の時間を持てますものね
dialogue.English: I see. That's good to hear. Being alone does give you more time to concentrate and have your own time, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ただ、なんでこうなっちゃったのかがわからないんです
dialogue.English: It's just that I don't understand why things turned out this way.

dialogue.content: なんとお呼びしたらいいでしょうか？もしよろしければ一緒に考えていきましょう
dialogue.English: What would you like me to call you? If you're comfortable, we can think this through together.

dialogue.content: みくです
dialogue.English: It's Miku.

dialogue.content: みくちゃんですね　ありがとうございます今までのお話を少しまとめさせていただいてもいいですか？
dialogue.English: Miku. Thank you. Would it be alright if I summarized what we've talked about so far?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: みくちゃんは　今１５才の中学生です１年前に今のクラスに変わってから　グループにはいるタイミングを逃して　親しい友人に恵まれず　いつも一人で過ごしていました
dialogue.English: Miku, you're a 15-year-old student. A year ago, when you moved to your current class, you missed the chance to join the groups that were forming. Since then, you haven't had close friends and have been spending your time alone.

dialogue.content: そのうちに　クラスの人たちから無視されているように感じ　一部の男子生徒とはお話ができるけど　周りが気になって自然と話をすることができなくなってしまったのですね
dialogue.English: Over time, you began to feel ignored by your classmates. And while you can talk to a few of the male students, you've become conscious of others watching, which has made it difficult to talk naturally.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 一人で本を読んだりすることは好きだけれどやっぱり今のクラスには馴染めないとお感じなのですね
dialogue.English: And while you enjoy reading books by yourself, you still feel that you don't fit in with your current class.

dialogue.content: これまででいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: How does that sound so far?

dialogue.content: 何がですか？
dialogue.English: What do you mean?

dialogue.content: いままでのお話をまとめてみたのですが、どこか気になるところなどありましたか？
dialogue.English: I was summarizing our conversation. Was there anything that didn't sound right or that you wanted to add?

dialogue.content: いえ、その通りです
dialogue.English: No, that's correct.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます　みくちゃんは　お一人でいるのはなんとなく寂しいと思われているようですが、男子生徒とはお話ができる人はいるのですよね
dialogue.English: Thank you. Miku, it seems you feel a bit lonely being by yourself, but you mentioned there are some male students you can talk to, right?

dialogue.content: その人とはお友だちにはなれないのですか？
dialogue.English: Is it possible to be friends with them?

dialogue.content: それはムリです
dialogue.English: That's impossible.

dialogue.content: 話してるだけでガン見されるんですよ
dialogue.English: Just for talking to them, I get stared at intensely.

dialogue.content: やっぱり、クラスで一人で浮いてるっておかしいんですね
dialogue.English: I guess it is strange to be alone and stand out in class, after all.

dialogue.content: 私は別にどうでもいいんだけど、高校に行けば大体の子とは離れちゃうし
dialogue.English: I don't really care, and once I go to high school, I'll be separated from most of them anyway.

dialogue.content: そうなのですねガン見されているようにお感じなのですね一人でいることは別に問題はないことだと思います　ただ
dialogue.English: I see. So you feel like you're being stared at. I don't think there's anything wrong with being alone. However...

dialogue.content: みくちゃんがお一人でいたいのか　いたくないのか？　その辺りの気持ち次第だと思います
dialogue.English: I think it depends on how you feel about it, Miku. Whether you want to be alone or not.

dialogue.content: はい、一人で良いんです。ただ、なんでこうなっちゃったのかがわからないんです
dialogue.English: Yes, I'm fine with being alone. It's just that I don't understand why things turned out this way.

dialogue.content: 今のクラスになるまでは　どうでしたか？
dialogue.English: What was it like before you were in this class?

dialogue.content: もともとおしゃべりじゃないけど、普通に話す子はいました
dialogue.English: I've never been very talkative, but there were kids I would talk to normally.

dialogue.content: それは良かったですねその子とは今でもお話とかできていますか？
dialogue.English: That's good to hear. Are you still able to talk with them now?

dialogue.content: クラスが違うので話してはいません
dialogue.English: We're in different classes, so we don't talk.

dialogue.content: クラスが変わったら中々話かけづらいですねみくちゃんにとって　お友達と呼べるかたはどのような方かお聞きしてもいいですか？
dialogue.English: It can be hard to talk to people when you're in different classes. Miku, may I ask what kind of person you would consider a friend?

dialogue.content: うーん
dialogue.English: Hmm...

dialogue.content: 難しいかな
dialogue.English: Is that a tough question?

dialogue.content: ゲームで出会う人が一番話しがあうかな
dialogue.English: I probably get along best with the people I meet in games.

dialogue.content: ゲームの中で出会った友人ということ？リアルの世界でも会えますか？
dialogue.English: So, you mean friends you've met in games? Do you meet them in the real world as well?

dialogue.content: リアルでは会わないですよ、誰だかわからないし
dialogue.English: I don't meet them in real life—I don't even know who they are.

dialogue.content: 先生とかも高校に行ったら人間関係変わるって言ってるし
dialogue.English: My teachers also say that relationships change once you get to high school.

dialogue.content: では　ゲームの中で会話をすることが一番よい関係になれるのですね楽しそうですね
dialogue.English: So, talking within games is how you can form the best relationships. That sounds fun.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お話が弾む感じなのですか？　今はその中にお友達はいるの？
dialogue.English: Do the conversations flow well? Do you have friends in that space now?

dialogue.content: 友達ってやっぱりいないとへんなんですね
dialogue.English: So it is strange not to have friends after all, isn't it?

dialogue.content: そういう事ではないですよただ、みくちゃんの気持ちが楽しい
dialogue.English: That's not what I meant. It's just about whether you, Miku, are having a good time.

dialogue.content: と思える時間を持てたら
dialogue.English: If you can have moments where you feel happy,

dialogue.content: リアルな世界でも　もっと人と接する事ができるかなと思いました
dialogue.English: I thought that maybe you could connect more with people in the real world, too.

dialogue.content: 話す人いないから学校では辛いと言えば辛いけど、いじめられてるっていうのとは違うから、卒業しちゃえば嫌な子とも離れるって思ってすごします
dialogue.English: Since I have no one to talk to, school is hard in a way, but it's not like I'm being bullied. So I'll just get through it by thinking that once I graduate, I'll be away from the people I don't like.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 少し時間が過ぎてしまいましたが、私ももう少しみくちゃんとお話できたらとおもいました。
dialogue.English: We've gone a bit over time, but I also feel like I would have liked to talk with you a little more, Miku.

dialogue.content: はい、また周防段に来ます
dialogue.English: Yes, I'll come for counseling again.

dialogue.content: 相談に来ます
dialogue.English: I'll come for counseling.

dialogue.content: また　ご相談にきてくださいね
dialogue.English: Please do come for counseling again.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: （ロープレありがとうございました）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for the role-play.)

dialogue.content: （失礼します）
dialogue.English: (Excuse me.)

dialogue.content: では、終了いたします　本日はありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Then, we'll end the session here. Thank you for your time today.
